insights.one_liner: Nijmegen research lab building record-strength magnets and infrared/THz lasers for physics and chemistry research; a good fit for science graduates.

culture.text: About 69 people, many trained in physics, chemistry and materials science at Radboud, HAN and TU Delft, plus German universities.
An educational research institute focused on high magnetic fields, semiconductors, 2D materials and free-electron lasers.
